title: Walsh characters under coordinate projection
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $J\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, let $\gamma\in\mathbb F_2^{|J|}$, and let $x\in\mathbb F_2^n$. Project $x$ onto the coordinates in $J$, ordered by their indices, and lift $\gamma$ to a vector in $\mathbb F_2^n$ by extending its corresponding frequency vector by zero outside $J$. The Walsh character indexed by $\gamma$ evaluated at the projection of $x$ equals the Walsh character indexed by this lifted vector evaluated at $x$.
